clarifications.correction: The diagnostic exhaustively evaluated all sixteen equal-size spatial tiles. Their arithmetic mean is the exact expected outcome for selecting one tile uniformly from that fixed set. There was no separately sampled random-block arm or random-seed distribution.
clarifications.analysis_consequence: Report the exhaustive uniform-tile expectation as such. Do not describe it as an independently run random-control arm or use it to estimate random-seed variability.

clarifications.correction: The XMem candidate protocol's reference to a matched random-block control does not describe the completed fixed-history diagnostic. That diagnostic contains exhaustive single-tile removals, whole-source removal, and two fixed unions; it contains no separately sampled random-block control.
clarifications.analysis_consequence: Any future XMem study must define and freeze its own matched control before training. The completed diagnostic cannot be retroactively treated as that control.
